data.body: Consideration: [Implicit shared state] Idempotency requires a precise v2 detection sentinel — define in S1 schema doc (e.g., a 'schema_version=2' line OR detect array syntax 'stack=(...)' as the sentinel). S4 must assert: (a) v2 file is no-op on re-run; (b) hand-edited v2 file containing v1-style 'stack=value' syntax is detected and rejected (not silently re-migrated). Add explicit test cases for each path.
